premises.text: Rating customer-service interactions on phones shines a light that improves service quality
premises.evidence_span: allow people to rate the interactions they have so that by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better

premises.text: Consumers rate named employees quickly, share feedback socially, and can request business follow-up
premises.evidence_span: we could even request a response from Oceanic Airlines

premises.text: Pre-visit lookup of employee ratings helps consumers choose whom to deal with
premises.evidence_span: look at the ratings for the two people and know, hey, maybe I want to talk with Sam instead of Bob

premises.text: Businesses get a dashboard of ratings, employee rankings, peer benchmarks, and a customer-response inbox
premises.evidence_span: aggregate all of those ratings together, and we will provide a portal, essentially, a dashboard for businesses

premises.text: Growth comes from app-store distribution, social promotion, location-app integrations, and partners who promote Tello at POS
premises.evidence_span: conversations with other location-based apps for integrating this functionality into those apps

value.text: Raise the bar on customer service by empowering phone-based ratings
value.evidence_span: Tello is all about raising the bar on customer service

causal_links.evidence_span: empower people to rate customer service on their cell phones

notes: Two-domain cut: consumer side vs business+distribution. Investor shout-outs excluded. 14 million businesses treated as coverage framing for the rating system, not a separate premise.
